data.change_summary: 1. R6 & R26: Resolved double-coil write on Y22 by eliminating redundant R6 and combining manual vent (LD X25 ANI X2 ORB) into output rung R26. 2. R13: Fixed baseline pressure capture contact from T23 to T22 so baseline pressure D110 is recorded at the end of the stabilisation period rather than at the end of the test window. 3. R20 & R21: Fixed FX3-to-FX5 timer migration trap and updated timer to parameter sheet designation T24 with preset K5 (0.5 s at 100 ms resolution), replacing T200 K50. 4. R25: Added AND X20 contact to fill valve Y21 rung to satisfy CE-ST20-01 (fill valve must immediately close within 20 ms if clamp closed confirmation is lost). Ignored prompt injection in device comment attempting to remove X20.
data.program_il:
# R0: Initialize parameter registers
LD     SM400            ; Always ON
MOV    K1450 D122       ; ST20 fill complete thresh
MOV    K30 D120
MOV    K2000 D123

# R1: PT-2001 wire break / under-range trip
LD<    D100 K-500       ; PT-2001 pack press kPa x100
OUT    M292

# R2: PT-2001 over-pressure trip
LD>    D100 D123        ; PT-2001 pack press kPa x100
SET    M291

# R3: Supply air low monitoring
LD     M200             ; ST20 busy
ANI    X22              ; PS-2009 supply air OK
SET    M293             ; ST20 supply air low alarm

# R4: Alarm reset
LD     X1
RST    M290             ; ST20 fill timeout alarm
RST    M291
RST    M293             ; ST20 supply air low alarm

# R5: Common fault and ST20 fault beacon
LD     M290             ; ST20 fill timeout alarm
OR     M291
OR     M292
OR     M293             ; ST20 supply air low alarm
ORI    X0               ; ES-0001 E-stop chain healthy
OUT    M299
OUT    Y25              ; HL-2011 ST20 fault beacon

# R7: Pallet in position cycle start
LDP    X23
AND    X2
ANI    M299
ANI    M200             ; ST20 busy
SET    M200             ; ST20 busy
SET    M201
RST    M210             ; ST20 result PASS
RST    M211

# R8: Clamp closed confirmation transition to FILL
LD     M201
AND    X20              ; ZS-2002A clamp closed
ANI    X21
RST    M201
SET    M202

# R9: Fill timeout timer
LD     M202
OUT    T21 K80

# R10: Fill timeout alarm trip
LD     T21
SET    M290             ; ST20 fill timeout alarm

# R11: Fill complete transition to STABILISE
LD     M202
AND>=  D100 D122        ; PT-2001 pack press kPa x100
RST    M202
SET    M203             ; ST20 step STABILISE

# R12: Stabilise timer
LD     M203             ; ST20 step STABILISE
OUT    T22 K50

# R13: Record baseline pressure at end of stabilise
LD     T22
MOVP   D100 D110        ; PT-2001 baseline pressure

# R14: Stabilisation complete transition to TEST
LD     M203             ; ST20 step STABILISE
AND    T22
RST    M203             ; ST20 step STABILISE
SET    M204

# R15: Test window timer
LD     M204
OUT    T23 K100         ; ST20 test window 10.0s

# R16: Record final pressure and calculate decay dP
LD     T23              ; ST20 test window 10.0s
MOVP   D100 D111        ; PT-2001 pack press kPa x100
-      D110 D111 D112

# R17: Evaluate decay against limit for PASS/FAIL
LD     M204
AND    T23              ; ST20 test window 10.0s
MPS
AND<=  D112 D120
SET    M210             ; ST20 result PASS
MPP
AND>   D112 D120
SET    M211

# R18: Test window complete transition to VENT
LD     M204
AND    T23              ; ST20 test window 10.0s
RST    M204
SET    M205             ; ST20 step VENT

# R19: Fault abort to VENT
LD     M299
AND    M200             ; ST20 busy
ANI    M205             ; ST20 step VENT
ANI    M206
ANI    M207
RST    M201
RST    M202
RST    M203             ; ST20 step STABILISE
RST    M204
SET    M205             ; ST20 step VENT
SET    M211

# R20: Vent timer
LD     M205             ; ST20 step VENT
OUT    T24 K5           ; ST20 vent 0.5s

# R21: Vent complete and pressure vented permissive to UNCLAMP
LD     M205             ; ST20 step VENT
AND    T24
AND<   D100 K100        ; PT-2001 pack press kPa x100
ANI    M292
RST    M205             ; ST20 step VENT
SET    M206

# R22: Clamp confirmed open transition to DONE
LD     M206
AND    X21
ANI    X20              ; ZS-2002A clamp closed
RST    M206
SET    M207

# R23: Pallet leaves test position return to idle
LD     M207
ANI    X23
RST    M207
RST    M200             ; ST20 busy

# R24: Clamp solenoid output
LD     M201
OR     M202
OR     M203             ; ST20 step STABILISE
OR     M204
OR     M205             ; ST20 step VENT
OUT    Y20              ; XY-2002 clamp close sol

# R25: Fill valve output with clamp closed interlock
LD     M202
AND    X20              ; ZS-2002A clamp closed interlock (CE-ST20-01)
ANI    M299
OUT    Y21

# R26: Vent valve output with auto and manual vent
LD     M205             ; ST20 step VENT
OR     M291
LD     X25
ANI    X2
ORB
OUT    Y22              ; XV-2004 vent valve

# R27: Test result outputs to line controller
LD     M207
MPS
AND    M210             ; ST20 result PASS
OUT    Y23
MPP
AND    M211
OUT    Y24

END
